text:
sam: Kicking off staged rollout v2.14.3 -> 10% traffic (eu-west + us-west). Heat-check window 15m. Observability dashboard: https://dash.redwood/rolling/2143 :eyes:

deploy-bot: [notice] rollout started by sam at 1787654329. target_percent=10, variant=v2.14.3

maria: seeing a small uptick in reranker 5xxs in eu-west at +4m, ~0.8% -> 1.6%
kai: can you paste the log snippet?
maria: ```
2026-03-12T09:04:13Z ERROR reranker: timeout shard=4 seq_len=2048 req_id=kp-9b3
2026-03-12T09:04:15Z WARN  kvcache: miss rate 12%
```

olivia: is this only eu-west? us-west looks fine in the dashboards
maria: yeah mostly eu-west, small tail in us-west but within usual

sam: hold traffic increase. Requesting synthetic run + memory/kvcache check. If error rate >1.0% or p95 latency +25ms, we pause and evaluate. @oncall-bot run synth-check --scenario reranker-2048

oncall-bot: synthetic run started. 3 probes to eu-west, 3 to us-west. returning results...

oncall-bot: synth results: eu-west p95 +32ms, error_rate=1.9% (threshold 1.0%). us-west p95 +18ms, error_rate=0.6%

sam: that's above threshold for eu-west. stop rollout and initiate rollback to v2.14.2. Please confirm pin of v2.14.2 for eu-west and remove v2.14.3 from canary pool.
deploy-bot: [action] stopping traffic shift. rollback target=v2.14.2. rollback initiated by sam at 1787654370

kai: starting rollback hook: pin session-store=stable-2026-02-28 and set kv-cache-max-age=60s during rollback
maria: adding note: possible regression in reranker with long sequences when cache miss spikes. capturing logs to #postmortems later

olivia: do we want to run a smaller canary (2%) with extra observability after rollback?
sam: yes, after rollback stabilizes for 30m and synthetic passes, do 2% with enhanced tracing.
maria: recording release note update: "v2.14.3: rolled back due to reranker errors under high-seq workloads; investigating cache interaction."
sam: good. tagging releasenotes and eng-oncall for followup. thanks all. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [complete] rollback finished at 1787654382. traffic restored to v2.14.2 in eu-west/us-west.

kai: leaving a quick checklist in the release thread: 1) postmortem captures logs 2) reproduce locally with seq_len=2048 3) test kvcache tuning 4) re-run perf tests before next roll
maria: I'll take the repro and perf tests.
sam: i'll schedule the follow-up sync and update the release notes. closing this rollout thread.
olivia: thanks, team.
